answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 52 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in island, queued in lantern, and dune publishes the wait time. A farm of 62 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3253 identities would post 3889 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
